body:
## CI Failures Resolved

### Root Cause
The CI failure was in `npm test`, not lint/typecheck/build. The most recent commit (`1770fe2`) added a new test, `keeps two same-agent updates in date order`, that asserted **ascending** date order for two updates from the same agent. This contradicted the already-implemented and spec'd `buildChangelogFeed` sort (`b.date.localeCompare(a.date) || ...`), which is explicitly **newest-first** per the work item's acceptance criteria and is already covered/passing in the "orders entries newest-first across 3+ agents" test.

### Fix Applied
- Corrected the test's expectation to match the newest-first sort contract: same-agent updates should return `["Second", "First"]` (newest note first), not `["First", "Second"]`. Renamed the test to `orders two same-agent updates newest-first` for clarity.
- No changes to `lib/changelog.ts` — the implementation already matches spec (confirmed via the earlier approved review that fixed the `.slice(1)` bug).

### Verification (all run locally, matching CI)
- `npm run test` — 87/87 passing
- `npm run typecheck` — no errors
- `npm run lint` — no errors
- `npm run build` — production build succeeds

Pushed to `feature/changelog-data-feed` at `ea29a0c`.
